value.rationale: C4×C5 is the first non-hypercubic rectangular torus among square grids with four distinct neighbors and no triangles. The exact 1048576-state classification establishes natural population, basin, sharp entry-time and symmetry invariants that do not follow from general two-period convergence or already-periodic structural theorems. It provides a compact reproducible benchmark in a canonical 2D topology, not an arbitrary unmotivated slice.
